entries.subject: DAMIT model record
entries.finding: [DAMIT model record](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/5394) — selected original mesh and spin metadata.

entries.subject: Original shape table
entries.finding: [Original shape table](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/58886/shape.txt) — counted XYZ vertices and one-based triangle indices.

entries.subject: DAMIT documentation
entries.finding: [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/pages/documentation) — units, frame, spin definitions and archive license.

entries.subject: AcuA primary catalog
entries.finding: [AcuA primary catalog](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) and [Usui et al. (2011)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1106.1948) — thermal diameter, field meanings and limitations.

entries.subject: Hanuš et al. (2018)
entries.finding: [Hanuš et al. (2018)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.06116) — survey of accepted shape-aware size fits; included for Dike, Ducrosa and Petrina.

entries.subject: Magri et al. (2007)
entries.finding: [Magri et al. (2007)](https://echo.jpl.nasa.gov/asteroids/MBAs/magri.etal.2007.mbas.pdf) — independent radar and size synthesis; no mesh substitution.

entries.subject: Ďurech et al. (2020), Asteroid models reconstructed from ATLAS photometry
entries.finding: [Ďurech et al. (2020), Asteroid models reconstructed from ATLAS photometry](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...643A..59D)

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The selected release supplies a shape model and spin metadata, not a registered optical reflectance texture. Thermal diameters are disk-integrated quantities and cannot supply a thermal or regolith map.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive models: Model 5395: pole (234°, 38°), period 6.21513 h.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.
